title: Kage: Shadow any website for offline viewing, with the JavaScript stripped out
description:
You bookmark an article, come back to it later, and get a popup wall, autoplay video, and a paywall where the content used to be. Kage shadows it. It mirrors any website for offline viewing with all the JavaScript stripped out. clean, fast, permanent copies of pages you actually want to keep. Read on a plane, keep it after the original vanishes, skip the modern web's noise entirely. #github #opensource 

https://github.com/tamnd/kage
